Reference

Philosophy reference guide

A philosophy reference organised around one promise: every claim here can be checked. 696 quotations carry the work, the passage, and the edition they come from; 58 have been collated against the cited edition; the thinkers, works, and terms behind them are indexed below. For the scholarly deep ends, see the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy and the Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy — this guide is the quicker, sourced route to the texts themselves.
